nom: Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer

avis.texte: I have never received my package and was not provided any resolution , hope to get my money back.

I cant believe more reviews arent talking about how bad this pills. Because of the dimethicone, it has a very smooth silky texture, but it wont stay on my face because it pills off whenever something brushes my face.

I have been using this Neutrogena evenly clear acne moisturizer for about two weeks now. I apply shea butter afterwards to not dry out my skin. Most acne products dry my skin but this seems to have a nice feel to it

This product is amazing! A little bit goes a long way and it never clogged my pores. In fact it made my pores look better. Absolutely love this acne gel and would recommend it to anyone looking for a new moisturizer.
My skin responds well to the moisturizer and it felt great after using it . The first step was to clean the face then add moisturizer later.

This Neutrogena Evenly Clear acne gel moisturizer is gentle, has no fragrance, absorbs fast, and it isn't greasy. I like the pump style and there's a lot of product. I'm excited to try the product for a few more weeks and see how much my post-acne marks fade.

I been using Neutrogena evenly clear for about a week and it's been working on my skin for starters it's not braking me out since I have sensitive skin and it's light weight not greasy or sticky like some products I used before..

avis.titre: A must have item for pimples
avis.texte: After using the Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Moisturizer, I feel so impressed. I love it so much, It made my pimples heel so fast and leave the skin hydrated. I am strongly recommend this product to any of my friends.

avis.titre: Great for oily or combination skin!
avis.texte: My aging skin is changing due to perimenopause, and so are the needs of my skin products. I find that my combination skin has started to break out more often than it used to, and this moisturizer has been such a help! I use it after washing my face, and it is moisturizing without feeling like my pores are clogging. I like the light scent and how it absorbs into the skin. It has been a great addition to my routine when I feel a breakout coming on!

I've been using the Neutrogena Evenly Clear Gel Moisturizer for a few days now and I like it, but I haven't seen any major results. I'm thinking I may need to give it more time for there to be a bigger difference with my skin. It's very lightweight and more suitable for summertime in my opinion. It didn't irritate my skin at all, so I loved that.

Didn't over-dry my skin, but still seems to help quickly. Easy to use. I only get single pimples here and there, so I can't speak on chronic acne, but if you just get an occasional breakout it's pretty good.

avis.titre: Yes, its an acne gel moisturizer
avis.texte: This moistuizer is alright. Its nice that it doesn't feel heavy or makes my face look oily. It also doesn't make my skin feel dry immidiatly; but later in that day my face did start feeling a bit dry. I could definetly tell that it is an acne treatment after a while. Maybe this would work better if you used another moisturuzer with it.

This is a great product for acne breakouts. I use it as a spot treatment and it is very effective. I only apply to the affected area and it reduces the pimple much faster than without treatment. I especially like that this product hydrates at the same time. Most acne products are super drying and this has moisturizing properties so that it keeps your skin hydrated.
This is an excellent moisturizer. Beautiful formula, just enough hydration and not overly mattifying. but keeps oil in check. Love that it's fragrance free. This is my favorite one.
I like the texture of this product, as it is lightweight, non-greasy and it absorbs quickly. So far, I see some improvements to my skin and I will continue using. Good product.

avis.titre: Loved this moisturizer for my skin!
avis.texte: I really loved how smooth this moisturizer glided on my skin! It didn't break my skin out or leave it feeling greasy or too dry or flaky.

I used this moisturizer in the mornings and really liked the lightweight feel and smooth texture. There's no noticeable scent and the pump makes it easy to use. Unfortunately, it ended up being a little too drying for my skin.

This moisturizer works really well. I definitely think my skin looks better after using it. It is fragrance-free and is really easy to apply. I enjoy the pump dispenser as it makes it so easy to get just the right amount of product.

Although I do not experience frequent breakouts occasionally I will experience one so I was afraid this product may be too harsh for my skin but I was pleasantly surprised. I did not experience any issues such as over drying rather my skin stayed well hydrated. The product was a nice consistency and absorbed easily into my skin allowing me to apply make up over it without any piling. I would recommend this product.

This gel moisturizer is lightweight and doesn't have a noticeable fragrance. I started using it in the AM consistently and I did begin noticing smoother texture and reduction in acne around my chin specifically which has been a consistent problem area for me. I like that despite it having salicylic acid it doesn't feel harsh or extremely drying. I would definitely start off once a day and work up to twice a day of your feel you need it!

I tried Neutrogena's Evenly Clear moisturizer for two weeks and my skin looks better than ever. I love that it is a lightweight moisturizer with acne fighting properties built in. It saves me a step and has dramatically changed the texture of my skin and reduced breakouts. I highly recommend trying Evenly Clear moisturizer for acne prone skin.

Feels like your putting water on your face. Not sure if it was just around my time if the month or just this doing it's job. Any type of product like this with salicylic acid as it's main ingredient is going to make your face worse before it gets better. That just means it's doing it's job. But the texture reminds me of hair gel. Or aloe vera gel. I feel refreshed and honestly it made my skin feel more hydrated and softer.

neutrogena evenly clear acne gel moisturizer is a lightweight product that helps clear blemishes and brighten spots. After using the product for a few weeks, a few stubborn dark spots I had on my skin started to lighten up and it helped clear some hormonal acne flare ups. I will reach for this product when I need targeted treatment.

I love salicylic acid for acne and this has been one of the best products I've used. I'm a big fan of neutrogena and this was no exception. I used to use differin gel as an acne moisturizer but the benzoyl peroxide was too irritating. I use this every night and I will be purchasing again!!
i love the fact that the gel is nice and cool. it is also a great moisturizer and doesn't dry your face out. i would definitely keep on buying!!

I really appreciated how lightweight and non greasy this moisturizer was. As someone with combination skin, I was grateful that it mot.only hydrated my dry spots, but didn't exacerbate my oily areas. It was also super gentle on my skin, and absorbed quickly.

avis.titre: Nice Gel Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin that is also quite dry. Despite having acne, I usually stray away from salicylic acid due to it being so drying. When I was sent this product to review, I was hesitant to try it. I was pleasantly surprised that it didn't dry out my skin. My skin hasn't flaked, burned, or turned red. I've been using the moisturizer for 3-4 weeks, and my skin does seem clearer. It wears well under makeup, and it seems to sink into the skin quickly with no noticeable texture. I'd definitely recommend giving it a try if you're sensitive to salicylic acid typically.

Pro: easy to apply, doesn't bleach the fabric /towel as other acne's products. Cons: had been applying it twice a day for three days and those pimples/ acne still there. There was no sign of the pimple size decrease.

After my first time using this product I immediately added it to my daily rotation! I apply it after washing my face at night before applying my twice a day moisturizer. No harsh scent and it absorbs so quickly! It's keeping my skin clear of blemishes. 10/10 recommend

This Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer is great if you have acne, or even to use as a simple spot treatment for breakouts. I never struggled with acne growing up, but now I am dealing with hormonal acne on my chin in my early 30's. It's actually been quite painful at times and I've had constant breakouts over the last year. This has salicylic acid, a Beta-hydroxy acid (BHA) which studies have shown effectively reduces acne and regulates sebum production. I noticed an improvement in my skin after using for a couple of weeks. I have no new breakouts which is huge for me, and less redness and dark spots where previous breakouts were. I have relatively dry skin and haven't had any drying or discomfort yet from using this gel. It's going to stay in my skincare rotation.

Evenly Clear acne gel moisturizer really feels great on my skin. Non sticky feeling and fragrance free. No burning sensation on my skin and easy to apply. I noticed that my skin started to clear up and I will continue to use this product. I will tell others about the experience that I had with this product.

The product overall felt nice on the skin. I don't think it really did much for the acne however, it is hard to say because it might have prevented the acne that was already present from getting bigger.

After using this product a few times, I can say that it has potential. It goes on easily and doesn't feel heavy on my face. There wasn't much of a scent. Once it dried down my skin did feel a little flaky but it's possible I used too much. I also have fairly dry skin. I'm going to try it again when the weather changes and my skin isn't as dry.
I really enjoyed using this moisturizer. It's lightweight and unscented and goes on smoothly. It's almost translucent and it's sunk in really fast and absorbed quickly into my skin.

I was extremely impressed with this product. I used it as directed for 2 weeks and I didn't have one single blemish pop-up anywhere I applied it and the acne scars I have had for several years have considerably faded. This product feels very light on your skin and doesn't leave any kind of unwanted residue after you apply it. It just melts right into your skin, leaving it feeling absolutely amazing and looking better and better with every application. I am so in love with this product and will definitely be purchasing it as long as Neutrogena makes it! I highly recommend this product!! Neutrogena has aced it again!!!!
After 2 weeks of use I noticed a reduction of pimples that I get on the sides of my face. It's not very hydrating so I would suggest you use a more hydrating moisturizer on top of it.
This moisturizer is so good! The moisturizer makes my face so moist. I also like how there is a lock and has to turn the dispenser for it to open. I would recommend this and would buy it.
Loved using this after getting out of the shower! Made me feel clean and moisturized throughout the entire day!!! My skin is naturally oily and this didn't make me feel super oily!

avis.titre: Light-weight and not oily at all
avis.texte: As someone with acne prone skin, its rare to find a moisturizer that 1. doesnt break me out, and 2. doesnt feel gross and oily on my skin. This moisturizer has checked both boxes for me, and is a great drugstore option for a light-weight moisturizer!
I expected that it has some fragrance, but it's fragrance free. It's clear gel, but it doesn't feel sticky texture at all. I really like this product. My skin doesn't get feel dry after applying it.

I have extremely dry and sensitive skin. After using this product for several days, I noticed that my skin looks and feels smoother. The directions suggest using the product once a day for starters and gradually increasing to two or three times a day if necessary. I only used it once a day as my skin held its glow all day. There was no redness or dry itchy areas. My skin looks and feels amazing! I'm pleased with this product and will definitely continue using it!

I used this for about a week and noticed my pores starting to look smaller! I used this under my regular moisturizer and it did not irritate my skin at all. If you have dry/ acne prone skin this is for you! It won't dry you, yet works on acne!

This is a great preventative gel and helps if you have simple pimples crop up. It can be super drying though so it's best to use overnight and then in the morning apply moisturizing cream. It does take time to work so you may need to use patches or something else for tougher to tackle spots but if you know you have acne coming on you can apply ahead of time and it works great. It is not scented so it's perfect for sensitive skin.
This is great! It's non-greasy, very lightweight, and absorbs quickly. I wear it under makeup and you can't tell! No weird or abrasive smell and gentle enough to use daily.

I have been using Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel moisturizer for a few weeks now and I'm loving it. The gel is very lightweight and sinks in fast, not greasy but at the same-time keeps the skin hydrated all day. Highly recommended.
This product gave me such great moisturization. It made my face smooth and feel soft. After using for a week, I noticed significant age spot softening.

Another AMAZING Neutrogena product! I absolutely love this product when I get acne! It's soooooo nice and hydrating. I sually don't like acne gels because of the feeling after or the smell but this is one is the best one yet! It gets rid of acne quickly and leaves you feeling moisturized.

I use this product at night time. I personally hate layering products on my face that makes it sticky and oily. I found this to be super lightweight and hydrating but not to the point it made me feel oily. So far no reactions, it has no ordor. Highly recommend.

I tested the Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer, and I overall liked it! It was a lightweight gel moisturizer, that was easy to apply and did not pill. My skin felt hydrated, without feeling a cake layer or film. Overall impressed with this product!

The clear gel moisturizer was unscented and was gentle on my skin. It absorbed fast and felt closer to serum than moisturizer. I am not sure about the performance of this product in terms of treating acne as I currently don't have acne scar.

Tried this for a few days and had to stop using it. It didn't go well with my sensitive skin. Every time I put it on it would burn and leave my skin dry the next morning even with moisturizer. Wish it worked for me but too strong for my skin. Probably work for others!
A reliable choice when you want hydration and blemish control together. It keeps the skin smooth, balanced and clearer without heaviness.

I feel like with a product that claims to help/fix a problem you need more time to properly test. It's not gonna show results after one use. It requires consistent usage. I feel like it could work if given more time.
Moisturizer is gentle with a light scent. Didn't bother my skin at all and helped to keep it clearer and hydrated. Only needed a little to cover problem areas do it seems like it would last awhile

The Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer is a lovely moisturizer, it has definitely helped my acne. It absorbs well and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or strange. The packaging was a little difficult to utilize but eventually I figured it out.

This is truly a game changer. I have had mild acne, black and white heads. I used this for two weeks in my night skin routine. And i could see my skin started to clear up. Good part is it doesnt dry out my skin so much. Definitely worth.
I received this for Free in exchange for my honest review. This is good to have when you have acne. It is a clear gel and is easy to apply.
This product left a lot to be desired. The gel option was a nice choice, but overall, it wasn't very moisturizing. My skin saw no difference in moisture levels, making it ineffective.

I've been using This Neutrogena Clear Acne Gel for 2 weeks and I'm seeing a real difference. The texture is excellent. As soon as you put over your face, it is gone. It is a great light gel and non greasy for dairy use acting in post acne marks,

I have combination skin with occasional acne and breakout. I use this Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer in the morning, and layer another moisturizer on top of it at night. This gel moisturizer has a gel texture that's lightweight, absorbs quickly and non-greasy with semi-matte finish. It also layers well without pilling. The hydration is okay for morning, but not enough for night use, need to layer another moisturizer. I notice reduced redness and less breakout, but have not seen any improvement on dark spots.

I found this product to be very lightweight, and it easily dried down/absorbed into my skin. However, I didn't find it very moisturizing (in fact, it was a bit drying/made my skin tight), so I always made sure to use it as the second to last step in my routine before applying my regular moisturizer. I typically only used it at night for this reason, but I didn't have any issue laying products either. I have had a few breakouts since using it but nothing major, so I'm hoping that it's just my skin getting used to the new product and that it will start clearing things up soon.

Using Neutrogena's Evenly Clear acne gel moisturizer has been a real pleasure. The formula is buttery smooth and feels velvety on my face. It rubs in almost instantly too. I have been using this product on my problem areas- around my mouth, chin, forehead and some spots on the cheeks to avoid my face from becoming overly dry (which has not been a problem for me). While using, I have not experienced any significant negative effects, only improvement in my blemishes. I highly recommend this moisturizer for anyone who might suffer from skin blemishes/ acne.
I liked this moisturizer because it doesn't have a noticeable smell and it is easy to apply. It does seem to help clear my skin and I would recommend it.

I really enjoyed using the Evenly Clear Ance Gel. It went on smoothly and feels lightweight on the skin, not heavy or greasy at all. Most importantly, it cleared up my acne completely and I haven't any since using it. I experienced no irritation whatsoever which is great for sensitive skins.
It workes very well and leaves my skin smooth and everything it is a great product for all skin types and will definitely be using it.

avis.titre: If you have acne, you need this
avis.texte: I am obsessed with the Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer. It's insanely lightweight and sinks into my skin almost instantly, leaving it feeling fresh and hydrated not greasy at all. Since I started using it, my breakouts have noticeably calmed down and my skin looks more so much clearer and healthier overall. What I love most is that it moisturizes really well without clogging my pores or irritating my skin. I can use it everyday with zero redness or stinging, and it works perfectly under makeup too.

Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer is a lightweight, effective acne-fighting gel moisturizer that does what it claims without drying my skin. The bottle is on the small side, but a little truly goes a long way. This product has moisturized my skin and calmed down the irritation and returned my skin tone to being even. I really like the gel texture. It spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and never feels greasy or heavy. It layers well with other products. I definitely and highly recommend it.

As of lately I have been getting breakouts really bad. I have been using this Neutrogena evenly clear acne gel moisturizer for about 2 weeks now and it makes my skin really soft and my breakouts are not as common anymore. I really love this product!

Neutrogena does NOT miss!! I will start with the bottle because I love that it has a pump so I don't overuse product. I am really bad about that especially with acne treatments so this makes it easier for me to not overuse and get the most use out of it! There is a very light scent to the product and it is a nice light gel consistency. I think this works great. I get a few pimples during my cycle and a couple applications of this and it's pretty much gone. It's very effective. I would be cautious to not use it too much because you can peel but I'm used to being light with these treatments so I didn't have that issue. I'd recommend picking this up next time you're getting some acne treatment. 10/10!
Worked pretty good. Well please with results. Thanks for letting me sample this product. I would recommend to friends and family.

This moisturizer worked great for my acne prone oily skin. There was no added fragrance, but it still had a very neutral scent. When applied the product went on very smooth. It did not feel heavy and moisturized well. I would definitely use again.

I always enjoy the chance to test skincare. As a 33 yr old that sometimes still gets breakouts, I was excited to see this moisturizer contained acne fighting ingredients. The bottle is on the smaller side, but its good for on the go in a bag. I love that it is a pump bottle. I really loved trying this new product!
This product moisturizes without being oily and helped clear up my acne! I will be repurchasing this product and recommending it to my friends!
This product worked great for moisturizing my face without breakouts, made my face feel super soft, definitely adding it to my skincare routine.

I used this to the forehead breakout I get occasionally with my sunblock rotation, hormones, etc. I used it overnight and it worked really well. I had no drying issues with my skin and it was gentle although it cleaned out my skin really well. Highly recommend

This product worked pretty good for me and my acne outbreaks. The smell wasn't too bad, but I do have to say I did not love the texture. Felt this product worked pretty good and I would recommend and purchase again.

I received this Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer complimentary from Neutrogena and HomeTester Club in exchange for my honest review. As someone with combination to oily skin and occasional mild acne, I was looking forward to trying this moisturizer. I typically used a single pump for each application and only used once a day (although the instructions say you can work up to using it 3x a day if needed). It goes on easily and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky, tacky, or greasy residue. I did notice some very mild tingling on my first application, but I didn't experience any for following applications. It's very lightweight, and I think that the formula is a great option for those with oily skin. However, I'm a little unimpressed with the results. It's only minimally moisturizing (and can even cause drying, which feels contradictory), and I didn't see noticeable changes in my skin (skin smoothness, post-acne mark appearance, etc.). Only used a week, so maybe with longer use?

Since entering perimenopause, I have been struggling with hormonal breakouts. Neutrogena's Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer has been the perfect addition to my skincare routine to help reduce my breakouts! The lightweight gel lotion glides smoothly on my face and is not sticky or scented. The gel moisturizer also lays nicely under the rest of my skincare products and makeup. With aging skin, I was concerned that using an acne treatment might be too drying - but I have not noticed any decrease in skin hydration and plumpness since using this product.

avis.titre: Lightweight, calming great for daily use
avis.texte: I absolutely loved it. It really helped me calm my acne but at the same time the texture is so light and comfortable that I can wear it everyday day. I'm extremely sensitive when it comes to textures, they make my skin feel like suffocating and uncomfortable so that was a plus for me. I also loved the fact that it works very good under make up: no flaking at all, smooth, calm skin!

Neutrogena always has some of the best products and this one doesn't disappoint. It is a lightweight,fragrance-free, non-greasy formula. It absorbs quickly yet moisturizes well. All while treating acne issues. If you have acne you know that your face can be sensitive to certain skin care products. This one however knocks it out of the park without any irritation at all.

Neutrogena makes good quality products! This is a good product to use if you have acne or a zit. You just need a small amount of the gel moisturizer! I found it to be slightly sticky but it did not irritate my skin and does a good job of shrinking the size of your zits! This is a good choice for anyone suffering from acne!

This product is gentle on my skin and doesn't dry it out like other acne moisturizers do. The scent is just right, not too strong. Easy to apply this evenly over the skin and it absorbs quickly. This is another great Neutrogena facial care product!

With a lightweight smooth gel that glides across your skin and a pump top container makes this easy to apply. It absorbs into your skin without a sticky or greasy feeling. Although the smell is not the most pleasant (think clean medical antiseptic ) luckily it doesn't seem to linger.

avis.titre: May cause smooth, acne free skin!
avis.texte: I'm officially addicted to the Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer. It worked very effectively for those pesky hormonal breakouts and made my skin feel smooth as silk in the morning! Don't skip this one!

I like that this moisturizer was formulated as a gel moisturizer because it is a very lightweight consistency on the skin, which both absorbs quickly and also does not further aggravate the oily, acne-prone areas of my skin. I would directly apply this moisturizer to problem spots, like areas where pimples are about to form/have formed to speed along its resolution. It helps to not only either prevent pimples from fully forming but also can help with acne that are still healing, making it an effective spot treatment for those problem areas. The treatment is more gentle than other salicylic acid treatments because it is paired with the hydrating and soothing gel moisturizer but you still have to be careful with continual or consecutive usage of it because that could sometimes lead to more sensitive, dry patches. Overall, great treatment product to add to skincare for anyone looking for moisturizers that will cater to acne-prone skin's needs.

I have combination skin, with acne breakouts mostly on my chin and cheeks, and this moisturizer really helped with reducing my breakouts and the redness caused by acne. I put it on every morning as part of my skin care routine, after cleansing my face. It's really lightweight and nongreasy, and absorbs into my skin quickly. It feels really hydrating without being too heavy. I feel like the amount of acne has started to reduce since I started using this gel. I highly recommend this for people who deal with acne breakouts and want something that isn't heavy and greasy.

This is absolutely amazing for clearing clogged pores! I tried a new tan product and found my face covered in clogged pores and small breakouts soon after. I tried the evenly clear and by the end of the week they were all gone. Not irritating on my sensitive skin and doesn't feel sticky, will definitely be buying again.
This is such a great gel moisturizer for my acne prone skin! Not only does it hydrate my skin but while fighting my acne it does not dry my skin out at all! Highly recommend to all!

This gel feels silky when applied. It has no fragrance and absorbs almost immediately. It leaves the skin when applied feeling soft and silky. The addition of salicylic acid is great for acne prone skin.

Neutrogena acne gel works really well on my acne. I can see my acne is faded after a week using it. The gel is light weight, no scent and absorbs quickly into my skin. I use it day and night without reaction.

This moisturizer has such a nice texture, applies really smoothly, and absorbs quickly. It doesn't leave my skin feeling tacky afterward. I have combination skin that is slightly sensitive, and I haven't noticed any irritation while using this product. I've only used this for a few days so far, so I can't comment on effectiveness for acne or hyperpigmentation. The bottle is definitely smaller than I expected, so I'm not sure how long it will last.
I have been using this product for a weeks and I can see improvement in my active acne. Even the redness on my face has subsided. I would seriously recommend this to everyone in need.

Lightweight gel that evenly absorbs into the skin. Product contains 0.5% Salicylic acid and 2% N-Acetyl Glucosamine. Personally, the peoduy cleared a couple blemishes and moisturized my face. I would recommend this product

I recently was given the opportunity to try Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer. It is a lightweight gel formula that absorbs quickly into my skin and doesn't interfere with my other skincare products. There was no residue and no fragrance that I noticed. My skin has been pretty clear recently, but I did notice that an incoming eruption never fully materialized while using the product, and the swelling went down quickly. Overall, I would say this is a promising addition to my skincare regimen as I don't care for acne products that involve white spots of product to cover or wearing a patch. This product disappears completely into your skin with no need to cover anything.

I have found the Everly Clear acne moisturizer to be a great product for my hormonal acne. It is not too abrasive on the skin and did a great job clearing up unexpected breakouts. I definitely recommend giving this a try!

This is a pretty good product. It rubs in well and a little goes a long way. It definitely works for my skin and has helped shrink or disappear some small acne spots. It is however, very drying on my skin. After one use and my skin already feels dry so you definitely have to moisturize extra when using this.

I really like this product. It worked and didn't cause any drying like a lot of acne treatments do. I hope the simple, no fuss design on the bottle keeps it affordable so that I may purchase this in the future. Thank you for allowing me to review this wonderful product!

Neutrogena's Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer works super well to combat acne on my oily/combination skin. It is a bit drying, so I like to pair with other hydrating products. The gel texture feels amazing on my skin and it absorbs relatively quickly. I would definitely recommend!

So i have always been a huge fan of Neutrogena products. This is a product for your acne. I love the texture is very lightweight and has a gel texture . It blends in very well and smooth. The best part is non greasy formula. I've been using this product for a while now and has effective worked great. It does hydrated your skin. Also helps with ance , which I have seen a different in my skin.

So I used this product for about two weeks and noticed that my skin was a lot more smoother and brighter. I definitely think my acne marks will definitely fade further the longer I use it. I really liked that it was fragrance free and lightweight.
Wonderful for acne prone skin. It's lightweight, absorbs instantly and is non-greasy. I find it moisturizing even with treating acne.

I've been really happy with this moisturizer so far! The gel texture is lightweight, easy to apply, and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy on my skin. I like that it helps with my acne, while still providing hydration, which is something I usually struggle to find in acne products. After using it, my skin feels smoother and clearer, and I haven't experienced irritation or dryness. It layers well with the rest of my skincare and feels comfortable for everyday use.

I received a bottle of Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer at no cost as part of a Home Tester Club program. I am a frequent purchaser of Neutrogena products and was excited to give this new type of moisturizer a try. My favorite part about this product was the consistency and texture. Acne products are typically oily and liquid-based while this moisturizer felt the same as any face lotion. It was easy to apply and came in a pump bottle. It absorbed into my skin quickly and was able to be layered with sunscreen and other products that I use daily. I also was pleased with the acne clearing component of this moisturizer. Even through stressful and hormonal times, my skin remained clear. I definitely will be adding this product to my daily routine and highly recommend it to anyone who suffers from breakouts and dislikes the oily texture of typical acne products.

I tried Neutrogena's Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer that I received to trial, in exchange for my honest review. I really appreciated that it glided on smoothly and absorbed quickly! It didn't feel heavy or excessively drying. In just two weeks I felt like I had fewer pimples too. It didn't really have a noticeable odor either. Thank you for allowing me to test this one out, I will likely buy this again for my teenage son, whose fights the seemingly ever-lasting acne phase every day, and has the battle scars to prove it! I feel like it may give him a shot at winning the war.
This Everly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer works so well. It's easy to use and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. My skin looks better than ever in a few weeks of use.

It's not common that you can use hydrating and salicylic acid in the same line but I feel like this lotion is a combination of both. I used this lotion at night as a preventative because I'm not really experiencing any breakouts. I feel like it kept me clear and was not too drying. It's scent free and really lightweight. It is supposed to help fade scars and acne marks which is great. I didn't have any at the time to test that on but who doesn't like that in a product! Overall, I like this lotion and will continue using it at night possibly in the mornings too if I start experience breakouts.

The Neutrogena Evenly clear acne gel moisturizer is a product that does what it says. I like the easy to use dispenser that makes applying the product simple. The product is lightweight and little no no scent. It absorbs nicely into the skin and doesn't dry my skin out. It provides treatment for existing acne and what I also like is that it helps with lightening the scars of previous acne. This is a great addition to any skincare regimen and I highly recommend!

I received this product as a free sample in exchange for my honest review. If you're looking for a non-nonsense acne moisturizer that does exactly what it claims, this one delivers. This lightweight gel aborbs quickly and never feels greasy, making it especially appealing for oily or acne-prone skin. Thanks to the salicylic acid, I noticed a couple of blemished healed faster than they normally would without an active treatment - nothing dramatic overnight, but enough to be genuinely effective. It's also fragrance free, which is a huge plus if your skin is sensitive or easily irritated. As expected Neutrogena lives up to its reputation: gentle, dependable, and effective without being harsh. The only reason I did not give it 5-stars is because drier skin types may want a bit more hydration - but for oily skin, definitely a staple worth keeping in rotation. I will likely try it again in the summer when my skin isn't as dry, I'm sure it will work better for me then.

I haven't had to use much of this because I wasn't experiencing many breakouts. I like that fact that this isn't greasy on the face and rubbed into my skin well. I was afraid to use it daily as I didn't want my skin to dry out and become flaky. I'm really curious as to the results I would get if I had a bigger breakout and used this. I will be keeping it on hand for future use.
I really like this moisturizer. It is lightweight, absorbs quickly into my skin, and is not greasy. It dried out my acne without harshness.

First of all, it says right on the package that it can cause excessive drying... how can it even be called a moisturizer if it dries out your skin? If Neutrogena wants to call it an acne treatment, that's fine, but it does not moisturize. Second, it leaves a sticky feeling on the skin. I prefer a lightweight moisturizer that feels like next-to-nothing on the skin. Neutrogena Evenly Clear left my face red and irritated, even slightly itchy feeling. I will not use it again, and do not recommend it to anyone looking for a moisturizer.
I love a neutrogena face product and a good moisturizer. I've only tested it for a couple of weeks but it's a nice moisturizer and I do think it's been helping with some acne scars.

avis.titre: What a find!! This worked so good
avis.texte: This is a nice balance of hydration and acne treatment. It doesn't feel heavy like cream and more therapeutic value beyond basic moisturizer. It also targets breakouts and post acne scareing

I really liked this moisturizer. I noticed a difference in the appearance of my acne scars, and it definitely seemed to be helping with current breakouts. It didn't dry my skin out or irritate my acne, which I appreciated.

This product worked well! No overwhelming fragrances like so many products, didn't dry out my skin, felt smooth going on and absorbed quickly into my skin! I don't get breakouts very often but this worked when needed.

I occasionally get hormone-induced acne so I was excited to try this out. I love the light feel to it, its definitely lightweight and doesnt leave behind residue. From my experience it comes through on the acne reduction. I was on the cusp of a flair up and the next day it was gone. But the moisturizing part leaves a lot to be desired. It's just not enough on its own for my skin type. I think Id only use it on those days/nights where I need it and follow up with a hydrating mask or something.

The Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer absorbed into my face very well and did not leave behind a film or sticky residue. It did not dry out my skin either which is great because of it being a gel moisturizer. I recommend it.

I like how easy it is to rub it in. It doesn't feel very moisturizing but it's smooth and didn't dry my skin out. I think it worked better for me on smaller pimples to make them go away but I think it helped larger ones from getting worse too.

avis.titre: An effective and gentle acne treatment
avis.texte: I have tried many acne gels over the years. This is definitely one of the better ones I've used. Straight out of the box, I appreciated the fact that the product didn't have a lid (less unnecessary plastic. The gel had no scent, was lightweight, and absorbed well into the skin. Additionally, I liked that the product had no burn. I put it on a bit of hormonal acne I was dealing with and it was super effective at removing the redness and swelling. I will definitely continue to use this in the future.

I tested Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer. The product went on well and did not have a strong odor. It also seemed to absorb well into my skin. However, it left my skin feeling tacky or sticky. It stayed sticky the entire day until I washed my face that evening.

As someone who is very prone to breakouts (especially around my chin) but lacks moisture in certain areas, this is a great solution for my combination skin. It's a much thinner formula than my typical every day moisturizer, which may not be enough for some in the winter - but it absorbs into the skin quickly and works well under makeup without irritating my skin. One thing I really appreciate about this product is there is zero fragrance making it friendly for all skin types. The box claims that this formula fades acne marks, and while it did not create any new issues I will need to use it a bit longer to determine if it speeds up the healing process compared my to my usual routine. Overall, it's a great product that has helped hydrate my skin while curbing some of the oil.

I think this worked OK my face felt moisturized afterwards. It is pretty good product. I would recommend the acne was almost gone and it just like moisturize my face. That was a soft smoother. I would definitely recommend to try.

This product is just ok. It didn't really seem to help my acne much. The product name is also a little misleading. It's called a moisturizer but it's a gel and it doesn't moisturize the skin. It actually dried my skin out and made it a little flaky in the places I used it.

The moisturizer might look small and the ingredients seem average, but I did find this to be a very gentle acne treatment from Neutrogena. I normally have issues with acne products burning; this was not the case with this moisturizer. A small amount went a long way and I think whatever this product is sold for is probably valid and worth it. I only had one light spot of a pimple in the last month and the next morning after lightly cleaning and applying this moisturizer my spot completely went away. I have sensitive, dry and rarely oily skin. I break out with only one pimple at a time and normally my acne goes away with treatment within 2 days on average. I normally use pimple patches and found this product to be about the same results as competing products without the burn of more intense options.
